name: lookup_dcookie
synopsis: int syscall(SYS_lookup_dcookie, uint64_t cookie, char *buffer, size_t len);
description: Looks up the full path of a directory entry specified by an opaque cookie identifier and copies it into a provided buffer. The kernel must hold a reference to the cookie for the operation to succeed.

parameters.name: cookie
parameters.description: An opaque identifier uniquely identifying a directory entry

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: Buffer to store the full path of the directory entry

return_value.success: Returns the length of the path string copied into the buffer
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: The kernel has no registered cookie/directory entry mappings, or the cookie does not refer to a valid directory entry.
The name could not fit in the buffer.
The kernel could not allocate memory for the temporary buffer.
The process does not have the capability CAP_SYS_ADMIN.
The buffer was not large enough to hold the path.
